reviews.title: Tracking isn’t great
reviews.text: This app is great for workouts. It is dependent on products sold by Katy Hearn, which for some workouts is frustrating. The other frustrating part is in the workouts tracking aspect is all over the place. It asks for reps/lbs when you’re doing body weight workouts or reps/lbs when it’s a timed workout. These mistakes occur throughout the app. Sometimes it tracks my last weight used and other times there’s no history of my workouts. The how-to videos are great. It’s ok for the price, I just wish I had a better record of my workout progress.

reviews.title: It’s a love and hate
reviews.text: Been on this app for about 7 yrs now and I enjoy the workouts and do the challenges from time to time and even coaching. Loved that! But the app has too many glitches and malfunctions, currently on my own workouts right now with the app and it has my progress all over. I’m suppose to be on week 3 and it takes me to week 5,7, or 8

reviews.title: Amazing Support!
reviews.text:
I hadn’t done a challenge in probably 5 years and am
Just completing one.  I love how the bases of the app/group have only improved!!  The support is the best and quick to assist/respond.  Plus the community of the other people is top notch!  Having so many women with the same mindset and goals is what everyone needs!!!

reviews.title: Makes my life easier!
reviews.text: Literally, everything you need all in one space! This app is easy to use and I love how it has so many options for everyone. Absolutely love the challenges and the support behind it. And the nutrition guide is a constant go to. You need this app in your life!

reviews.title: HIGHLY RECOMMEND
reviews.text: Very easy to use. I love the description and the video clip to tell and show you how to do each workout correctly. Having the journal tab all in the same app is perfect! I love it!!

reviews.title: My favorite workout app
reviews.text: You cannot go wrong with the Sesh app. So many great features starting with the videos to show us how each workout is done. I also love how the app allows us to track the last weight used as well as reps. The app also allows to track cardio, water, and macros. Everything you need for a lifestyle change is literally in this app.

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text: I have been using sesh for a while now and I absolutely love it!  The workouts are well designed, easy to follow, and effective.  I also really appreciate the progress tracking and built in journal.  They make it easy to stay consistent and see how far I have come.  You can tell a lot of thought went into every part of the app.  It’s affordable and feels like more than just a workout app.  Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Issues with site
reviews.text: Anyone having issues with the  site for over a week? Contacted tech support but they said the update would fix it and it’s still not fixed

reviews.title: Fitness for women
reviews.text: I love this app for both home and gym workouts. It’s so convenient to be able to log a session and have the app remember your previous workout! It’s also great being able to take the mental load off of figuring out what to do - the app just does it all for you, you just need to show up!

reviews.title: Fitness challenge
reviews.text:
Love how these Challenges keep us motivated and focused. Takes the guessing work out of our fitness routine! 

Can’t wait for the next one!

reviews.title: 60 Day Spring Shred Challenge
reviews.text: This challenge allowed me to find my love for fitness again. The workouts were amazing and top tier. It pushes you but also works each muscle group individually to give you amazing results. SESH is by far the best workout app I have used! Amazing workouts with real results. I’m so thankful I gave SESH a shot, it changed my life and gave me my love for fitness back!

reviews.title: Best Fitness App Ever!!
reviews.text: Find the perfect program for you to meet your current needs, number of days you can work out, weeks to get ready etc. So simple to follow but full of info to help you reach your goals all at a great price. Love the challenges they offer through the app as well.

reviews.title: So easy!
reviews.text: Takes the guesswork out of how to get started. There are so many programs to choose from, and there’s a level of accountability in participating in challenges that I really enjoy. I’m into my second year of consistently using the app and they continue to make improvements all the time.

reviews.title: A really great workout app!
reviews.text: This app has been such a game changer for me. I have always struggled to find and figure out a routine to help build muscle, and track my whole fitness journey. Sesh makes it so easy to follow each group of workouts and show you the correct way of doing workouts by reading and watching videos! I just completed my first 8 week program. I have felt more motivated these last 8 weeks then I have this last year I have spent watching random videos and just trying to figure out a routine for myself.

reviews.title: Life Changing App ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.text:
The Sesh Fitness app has been an absolute game changer for my fitness journey. It’s so easy to use and makes tracking my workouts, progress, and goals simple and motivating. I love how everything is laid out — no confusion, just results!

The best part is the coaches. They’re truly phenomenal — supportive, knowledgeable, and they genuinely care about helping you become your best self. You can tell they’re invested in your success, not just giving out cookie-cutter plans.

Since using Sesh, I’ve felt more confident, stronger, and more consistent than ever. If you’re serious about reaching your goals and want an app that makes it simple and enjoyable, I can’t recommend Sesh enough!

reviews.title: Sesh has changed the way I view myself
reviews.text:
I first joined Sesh back during Fit By Katy and fell in love. After multiple challenges I just wasn’t ready but then something clicked and Rep + Runs challenge, not only changed my life but saved it too. Not only was I one of the winners, but it completely shifted my mindset. The workouts are empowering, the trainers are motivating, and the community is full of real support and encouragement. Sesh didn’t just help me get stronger physically, it helped me believe in myself again.
If you’re looking for something that goes beyond a typical fitness app, this is it. Every session feels like a reminder that you’re capable of so much more than you think. 💪✨

reviews.title: Consistency is key
reviews.text: This app help keep you consistent with all of the amazing upgrades added to support your fitness goals. You not only have the workout generator, live challenges, past challenges, but you also can do daily check ins to keep yourself accountable. It’s amazing. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.title: You have to try it!
reviews.text: I’ve been using Sesh for a while now, and I really like it. They have different challenges throughout the year that help keep me on track, and it’s nice that you can make your own too. The app is easy to use, and it’s just helped me stay more consistent with my workouts. Definitely recommend if you need a little motivation to keep moving.

reviews.title: Sesh review
reviews.text: I started back doing workouts with Katy Hearn when you still had to print them out on paper. It’s come along way now with this amazing app. I’ve done a couple programs using the app and it has made my life so much easier. Not embarrassed to go to the gym because I knew what I needed to do. Also have done the at home workout too and loved it! I just had my first baby and have been trying to get myself back in shape again and this is exactly all you need to do it!

reviews.title: Love sesh
reviews.text: I’ve been using sesh since the start and I love it! Each exercise has videos of how to which is a must! Easy to find all workout programs, allows you to track reps and weights, nice variety to workouts, freebies of nutrition tips too. Def my favorite fitness app!

reviews.title: Loving it
reviews.text: Sesh has been something I’ve had for years since FitbyKaty and I love the variety of challenges and workouts. I just did the Run and Reps Challenge and I haven’t run in years. It gets you out of your comfort zone and changing up your workouts and it has been super helpful to try to build more consistent routines. The nutrition is a big factor too and I’ve seen the updates and work they’ve put into the app over the years. It is always evolving and getting better! The subscriptions are really nice because it has helped to have access to all the different programming and even being able to take a quiz to see what matches up with your life style the best. Loving it!

reviews.title: Overall great!
reviews.text: I love this app! Easy to use and navigate and very helpful. The workout generator is good but has some kinks to work out … if you don’t love the workout and choose to “regenerate” it basically gives you the same exact workout again which is frustrating; But the options like timeframe, areas to workout and add ons like core/warm ups are a great touch!

reviews.title: Very user friendly!
reviews.text: Using the sesh fitness app has made staying consistent that much easier. I used to go to the gym with an idea of what I was going to do, but never with an actual plan. I would spend more time trying to figure out what I would be doing that day vs actually working out. I'm on my second postpartum journey and I owe it all to sesh! This app has been life changing.

reviews.title: Life-Changing Consistency and Mindset Shift
reviews.text: Since joining Sesh, my workout routine has completely transformed. The structure and support the app provides have helped me stay consistent like never before. I’m not only seeing real changes in my body, but my mindset has shifted too—I feel stronger, more motivated, and more confident. Sesh makes it easy to show up for myself every day, and that’s been the biggest game-changer. Highly recommend to anyone looking for sustainable results and real growth—physically and mentally!

reviews.title: Easy to use!
reviews.text:
Love this app! Easy to use and so many workout plans to choose from during the different phases of life. I love the macro calculator and the run & reps challenge has 
been my favorite

reviews.title: Absolutely love!
reviews.text: This app has helped me feel so much more confident going into the gym, no more wandering around no knowing what or how to do something! Not only does it give written instructions it has a video for every work out so you know exactly what to do! You can start with a program or just use the generator! I recommend this to anyone especially beginners!

reviews.title: not free at all
reviews.text: not free

basically I might sound stupid for thinking this but I thought it was going to be free I went threw alot of the reviews and they had said nothing about money but for one workout it’s like 100 dollars not going to pay that much when I can find videos on YouTube.!

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for many years, and I love the workouts and challenges with it. The challenges are a way to hold myself accountable and be consistent, and the programs are something you get to keep forever! So you can go back and do a program if you really liked it. The workouts are easy to follow along, and they have a video example for reference if you don’t know how to do it. The check in section in the app is really helpful to get you to reach your goals. Would definitely recommend.

The only improvement I would suggest is to include in the workouts which muscle you are working for that specific exercise. It would help people know they’re working the correct thing.

reviews.title: Why does everything have to be subscription based?
reviews.text: Crazy expensive for workouts and exercise exercises. I can access and learn for free ridiculous

reviews.title: The only workout app you’ll need!!
reviews.text: This is the only workout app i use! I have done several challenges and have loved them all. If you have done previous challenges, you can find all those programs in spot and pick any workout from there. Each workout comes with video and written instructions. The app has a place to put your sets/weights and a timer to help with in between sets. Another bonus is the macro calculator! This app has everything you need to keep you on track. It’s seriously the only app you need!

reviews.title: So worth it!!
reviews.text: I got the sesh app over a year ago and it is so worth it! Best workout app I’ve had in a long time. I love the breakdowns, demonstration videos, and how you can log weight and reps for your workouts. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: My fav app
reviews.text: I have *finally* returned to the gym and have been consistent and it is thanks to the Sesh app. It takes the guess work out of my workouts so all I have to do is show up (and feel confident when doing so). I love being able to track my progress week to week and adjust my macros all in one app. There is truly a program for everyone.

reviews.title: I love Sesh!!
reviews.text: I’ve followed Katy Hearn for years. I’ve had her app FBK before it changed to Sesh. I enjoy the different workouts available. The workout generator is also nice if you’re not sure what to do. I did the recent challenge with a coach and really enjoyed the 1:1 and being able to message her when needed. It was helpful to have a nutrition guide. Great options for different lifestyles. If you haven’t joined, now is the time.

reviews.title: My go-to workout app
reviews.text:
I’ve been with Sesh since before it even became Sesh and it truly just gets better with time! I love the workouts and the ability to track your reps, sets and weights you used. The I also love the workout generator you can use if you don’t know what workout to do for the day. 

The workouts in the programs are top tier! You can find just about anything you’re wanting from beginner to very experienced and even postpartum.

The best part is the community you get from being a part of Sesh! It’s truly such a motivating experience all around. 10/10

reviews.title: Just do it!!
reviews.text: I have loved this app since I joined over 1 year ago. It helps me stay on task, gives me all the details I need to know to complete complex workouts in order to build muscle, lose fat, be more confident, etc. it has changed my life!!

reviews.title: So versatile!
reviews.text:
This app has changed the fitness game for me! It is so versatile, with the ability to choose from multiple programs, and then choose the gym or home version. You can complete a program with a no excuses approach being able to use this app from anywhere, with minimal equipment required. 
 
I was able to take this app on vacation with me, and complete an 8 week program without any trouble. As a mom of two young children, this is a complete game changer. 

The check in portion is an added bonus to keep you accountable and able to focus on changes in pictures, and inches instead of just the scale.

reviews.title: Makes working out achievable and empowering!
reviews.text: Sesh has truly been a game-changer in helping me get back into working out after having two babies. It takes all the guesswork out of training and makes it so easy to get into the gym and stay consistent. I love being able to watch form videos, log my reps, sets, weights, and even rest times all in one place. It’s made my return to fitness feel achievable and empowering!

reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text: I really wanted to enjoy this app especially since I paid for the year it keeps crashing out on me whenever I use the regenerate workout and I have to look for the workout again or look for something similar I already did. I feel like I just wasted my money for no reason.

reviews.title: Cost money
reviews.text: App costs money but before they tell you that they want all your information so they can send you stupid ads what a waste of time.

reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: The only fitness plan that has actually worked for me in this life time.

reviews.title: App Refresh is not good
reviews.text: The app refresh is horrible. It cancels out of everything mid-workout and I am not a fan of the new workout selection.

reviews.title: I’d give it more stars if…
reviews.text: It needs more world. It would be nice if could see the workout generator I did and a monthly calendar of my workouts and an option to reopen the workout generator if I accidentally hit complete.

reviews.title: Nutrition counseling
reviews.text: I am a registered dietitian & counsel patient 1:1. When my patients ask for advice on increasing physical activity this app is included in my recommendation’s !

reviews.title: Love love love!
reviews.text: I am an OG sesh user! I use the app on a daily basis, for whatever type of workouts I may need! It keeps me motivated and helps keep me on track! Thank you for this amazing app!

reviews.title: Post partum
reviews.text: I joined sesh when I was postpartum with my third son and it has helped me not only lose 20lbs, but with the help of my coach gave me the knowledge of  macros and the importance of eating ENOUGH. Yessss you can still lose weight eating 2000+ calories a day. Thanks coach stace, and thanks sesh! <3

reviews.title: Do it!
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a program to help you buckle down and see results, THIS is it! I was always hesitant about buying an “influencers” program, but I couldn’t be happier that I did. The community that comes with this app is amazing. As someone who was anxious in the gym, it’s amazing. It has videos and details of how to do each workout to sure best results and no injuries. If you’re thinking about it, just do it! You won’t be disappointed.

I’ve been a longtime follower of Katy and have loved watching her programs evolve from computer printouts to FBK and now to Sesh. Sesh is amazing for all levels of fitness , and I love going back and doing old challenges as well as using the new and improved workout builder - which the fact you can choose the amount of time you want as well as what equipment you have access to, makes it great for a one time home workout session during my kids nap times. Just keeps getting better!

reviews.title: Extremely expensive
reviews.text: This app costs $5-8 a month just to use and then with the exception of 1 workout, costs even more to get access to the workouts on it. The cheapest one I saw was $50! The app is great, but for that money I could be paying a personal trainer.

reviews.title: IT REALLY DOES WORK, IF YOU PUT IN THE WORK!
reviews.text: I have done two challenges. The first one was back in the early days where Katy herself was my coach. I decided to get on board because I still had my mom pouch that I was self conscious about. During the challenge, it reduced tremendously. I learned so much about healthy eating and exercise. The second challenge I did, my coach was Erica. She was wonderful, but I ended up jumping ship before the 8 weeks was up. I did feel like Erica truly cares about her clients. I am sure all Sesh coaches do. I can’t wait to do more challenges in the near future!
